ipos.about: Incorporated in 2003, Foodlink F&B Holdings (India) Ltd. is a food and beverage services company engaged in providing premium catering services and operating casual dining restaurants and cloud kitchens. Headquartered in Mumbai, Foodlink caters to weddings, social celebrations, corporate events and other large-scale gatherings. Its restaurant portfolio includes brands such as China Bistro, India Bistro, Glocal and Art of Dum. The company also operates through its international subsidiary in the UAE, expanding its presence in the global food and hospitality industry.

ipos.about: Incorporated in June 2022, Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries Limited is an integrated agro-processing company engaged in the manufacturing of Jaggery Powder, Khandsari Sugar, jaggery-based value-added food products, and sugarcane by-products. The company also operates a Cane Seed nursery, enabling backward integration in sugarcane cultivation. It serves both B2B customers through jaggery powder, Khandsari sugar, and by-products, and B2C customers through its "Feel Guddy" branded jaggery-based premix products, including Jaggery Tea, Jaggery Coffee, Instant Rice Kheer, Jaggery Laddoo, and Jaggery Lapsi.

ipos.about: Incorporated in April 1992, Mahanadi Coalfields Limited is India’s largest coal producer in terms of production, primarily engaged in the mining and production of non-coking coal. The Company operates mainly in the Talcher and Ib Valley coalfields in Odisha and produces various grades of coal, including washed and beneficiated coal, catering primarily to the power sector as well as industries such as cement, sponge iron, steel, aluminium and paper.

ipos.about: Incorporated in 1994, Crystal Crop Protection is a crop solutions company with agrochemicals and seeds as its core offerings. Its portfolio includes crop protection products such as herbicides, fungicides and insecticides, along with natural crop solutions like bio-stimulants, bio-protectants, plant growth regulators, liquid fertilizers and micronutrients. It also offer seeds for field crops, vegetable crops and flowers. The offerings are customized for Indian farmers through research and development (“R&D”) including by collaborations with various multinational companies, delivering relevant solutions that aim to enhance farm economics, yield, productivity and profitability.
